    Ambient specialization boundary for BGRS Figure 13E #

    The preceding Figure-13D argument proves that the two outer rays form a BGRS special zero. The pair dichotomy therefore supplies representatives with zero ordinary composite. This file records those representatives and proves that, in the same radical quotient used for Figure 13D, the four supplement statements printed by BGRS produce a forbidden Figure-13E Hom-bifunctor retraction. Distributivity combines the two middle statements into the one middle coefficient supplement at tau^2.
